purpose: Use mathematics, geometry, graph theory and carefully bounded physics analogies to improve the World Relational Atlas without turning resemblance into physical proof or decorative numerology.
master_rule: Adopt a formalism only when it solves a renderer, navigation, hierarchy, flow, uncertainty or comparison problem. A mathematical analogy does not establish a theological or physical identity.
epistemic_boundary: Earth geography remains geographic data in geographic coordinates.
Graph distance is relationship distance in the represented graph, not moral, causal or geopolitical distance.
Semantic hub geometry is navigation-only and never claims a real location.
Project spiral geometry is project geometry unless independently connected to a physical model with variables, units and observations.
42 degrees is an explicit North-gate visual parameter. It is not derived from Fibonacci, the golden ratio, a level count or a physical law.
Vortex/circulation language is promoted from metaphor only when the underlying edges are directed, weighted and have a defined quantity/period/unit.

trace_levels.equation: d_G(u,v)=min number of represented edges on a path from u to v
trace_levels.renderer_use: Trace hop 1, 2 and 3 are exact shortest represented hop distances under the active relation-type filter.
trace_levels.warning: Hop count measures only the current represented graph.

semantic_hub_phyllotaxis.renderer_use: Place navigation-only semantic modules around a selected country with a stable golden-angle progression rather than equal angular sectors. Adding a later module does not rotate every existing module and spoke alignments are reduced.
semantic_hub_phyllotaxis.warning: This is a packing/layout choice, not a claim that the country or project is physically Fibonacci-structured.

equations: A(X*)=0 for a candidate fixed point
axis_structural_flow.renderer_use: Treat Axis movement primarily as changes of representation/depth/scale rather than pretending it is another longitude/latitude coordinate.

equations: b=ln(phi)/(pi/2) for the recovered project quarter-turn scaling convention
project_logarithmic_spiral.renderer_use: Suitable for explicitly project-symbolic recurrence-with-change scenes or transition paths; not a default Earth-map relation curve.
project_logarithmic_spiral.warning: Do not force the golden spiral onto unrelated data.

spectral_graph_layout.status: recommended for future non-geographic graph plane
spectral_graph_layout.use: Use Laplacian eigenvectors to create deterministic layouts for dense nonspatial relationship views and reveal broad connectivity structure without inventing coordinates.
spectral_graph_layout.not_for: Do not replace geographic coordinates of real places with a spectral embedding.

hyperbolic_hierarchy.status: recommended experiment for Tree / rooms / deep hierarchy plane
hyperbolic_hierarchy.use: Hyperbolic space naturally allocates rapidly increasing room with depth and is therefore a strong candidate for large tree-like nonspatial hierarchies. Root/overview can sit near the center while deeper branches expand toward the boundary.
hyperbolic_hierarchy.not_for: This is a separate non-geographic view, not a distortion to apply to Earth.

hodge_edge_flow.status: recommended after directed quantitative flows exist
hodge_edge_flow.use: Decompose a directed edge-flow field into source-to-sink tendency, local cyclic feedback and global cyclic structure. This is the mathematically disciplined future home for 'vortex' questions in trade, finance, energy, information or other measured flows.
hodge_edge_flow.not_for: Do not apply to undirected symbolic relations or interpret curl as literal fluid vorticity.

physical_vortex.status: physics comparator only until a physical field is modeled
equations: v_theta = Gamma/(2 pi r) for an ideal point/free vortex
physical_vortex.use: Provides intuition about circulation versus radial distance, but only for a physical velocity field or an explicitly dimensioned analogue.
physical_vortex.not_for: Do not assign physical circulation, velocity or vorticity to social/theological graph edges without units and a model.

force_directed_layout.status: candidate for exploratory dense graph views
force_directed_layout.use: Spring/repulsion layouts can expose clusters interactively, but they should be secondary to deterministic spectral/hierarchical views because initialization can change appearance.
force_directed_layout.not_for: Visual closeness must not be described as evidence strength unless the objective function explicitly encodes it.

level_calibration.geographic_zoom: world -> regional -> country -> subnational is camera scale, not ontology.
level_calibration.trace_depth: BFS hop depth is graph-geodesic distance in the selected represented relation graph.
level_calibration.axis_depth: Axis/D1-D11 remains a typed project/formal analysis ladder owned by axis-formal-lenses; it must not be inferred from zoom or trace hops.
level_calibration.hierarchy_depth: Future Tree/Rooms depth may use a hyperbolic radial coordinate, but only in a separately labeled non-geographic plane.
level_calibration.time: Time/as-of is an orthogonal coordinate/filter and must not be folded into vertical height or graph distance.

spiral_calibration.fermat_vogel: rho proportional to sqrt(theta) / sqrt(n): best for distributing discrete sibling navigation nodes with near-even areal density.
spiral_calibration.logarithmic: r=a exp(b theta): best for self-similar recurrence/growth where multiplicative radial scaling is part of the intended project geometry.
spiral_calibration.archimedean: r=a+b theta: best when radius increases by a fixed amount per turn; relevant as a geometry class and as an approximate form in some rotating-outflow systems, but not automatically a Potatoverse law.
spiral_calibration.selection_rule: Choose the spiral family from the rendering/data problem; never choose one because the word spiral already appears in project canon.

rejected_shortcuts: Do not create 42 levels from the 42-degree North arc.
Do not make every spiral a Fibonacci/golden spiral.
Do not use golden-ratio proximity as evidence of meaning or truth.
Do not label undirected relationship cycles as vortices.
Do not give abstract theology fake latitude/longitude or fake physical altitude.
Do not make map height encode holiness, guilt, truth, karma or authority.
Do not let one geometric coordinate simultaneously mean zoom, hierarchy, timeline, evidence strength and spiritual level.
